title: SWI 2007-present (raster 12.5 km), global, 10-daily – version 3

### About
Averages the daily Soil Water Index product over 10 days. The data are produced every 10 days over the globe at the spatial resolution of 0.1° and with the temporal extent from January 2007 to present.

[View this dataset in Copernicus Browser](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/?zoom=9&lat=46.02622&lng=14.5253&themeId=DEFAULT-THEME&datasetId=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY&fromTime=2014-01-01T00%3A00%3A00.000Z&toTime=2025-06-12T14:36:02.078366&layerId=FAPAR&demSource3D=%22MAPZEN%22&cloudCoverage=30&dateMode=SINGLE&clmsSelectedPath=Vegetation%20Properties&clmsSelectedCollection=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY)
